name: Dotnet Suite
description: Grants the agents dotnet CLI capability through an allowlist, plus protections for sensitive .NET config files.

allowedCommands.label: Allowed Dotnet Subcommands
allowedCommands.description: Comma-separated dotnet subcommands agents may run. Entries may be multi-word (e.g. 'tool install') matching the full token after 'dotnet '. Empty (default) means none allowed.
